system.description: The hardest and the shortest-fused: Progress 8 against Pressure 3, so there is very little room to go wrong. The name is the real gate — it is the one thing in the four that no amount of coin buys, because somebody has to find out who did this.
system.text: Lore, Progress 8, Pressure 3. Lifts a curse — and you must name who laid it.
